pwa.chromium_body: One tap adds the icon to your home screen, like a native app.
pwa.ios_chrome_body: Chrome, Instagram, or WhatsApp cannot install the app. Copy the link, open it in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.
pwa.ios_safari_step1: Tap Share (square with arrow ↑) at the bottom in Safari.
pwa.ios_safari_step2: Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.ios_safari_step3: Confirm with Add. The icon stays on your home screen.
pwa.android_step1: In Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
pwa.android_step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
